sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in excellent form overall with seven wins in their last ten matches. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00), looking to maintain their title challenge against struggling visitors who sit second-from-bottom.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town visit Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October in a match between mid-table sides, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger teams. The day's standout clash sees Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, travel to Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (6th) face Foley Meir, and Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement-battle flavour matchup. Market Drayton Town take on New Mills, while Shawbury United visit Barnton and Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the latter two featuring struggling sides. The midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at home. By Saturday 10 October, focus shifts to Allscott Heath's trip to face Brereton Social, Bilston Town's home encounter with Crewe, Stafford Town's home clash against Wednesfield Community, Telford Town's visit to New Mills, Alsager Town's home match against Shawbury United, and Barnton's home fixture against Dawley Town—a full slate of matches with several involving sides jockeying for position in the middle and lower reaches of the table.
